OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter API key. Enables adapters/openrouter.js to dispatch to any openrouter:<vendor>/<model> mind. Without it, the openrouter provider is skipped (routing falls through to other providers in the chain).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for the generic OpenAI-compatible chat-completions adapter (adapters/openai-compatible.js) — OpenAI itself, or any compatible gateway pointed at via OPENAI_COMPAT_BASE_URL / OPENAI_BASE_URL. Not required for a no-auth local gateway.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key for adapters/gemini-api.js (text/image REST dispatch).
